issues.jp_before: 自転車[じてんしゃ]{で|de-means}速[はや]く走[はし]れ{ば|ba-conditional}走[はし]る{ほど|ba-hodo}、風[かぜ]{が|ga-subject}強[つよ]く感[かん]じます。
issues.problem: 風が強く感じます is grammatically marginal (感じる is transitive; would need 感じられます).
issues.action: Changed to 風{を|o-object}強く感じます and adjusted English.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{が|ga-sub-clause}深[ふか]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}深[ふか]い{ほど|ba-hodo}、駅前[えきまえ]{は/が|wa-topic}静[しず]か{に|ni-change}なります。
issues.problem: 夜が深い is unnatural; the idiom is 夜が更ける.
issues.action: Rewrote as 夜が更ければ更けるほど, updated why and lv to 2.

issues.jp_before: 人口[じんこう]{が|ga-sub-clause}多[おお]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}多[おお]い{ほど|ba-hodo}、電車[でんしゃ]{の|no-possessive}本数[ほんすう]{も|mo-also}増[ふ]えます。
issues.problem: English translation was awkward ('the more the number of trains also increases').
issues.action: Rewrote English: 'The larger the population, the more trains there are, too.'

issues.jp_before: 都心[としん]{から|kara-from}遠[とお]けれ{ば|ba-conditional}遠[とお]い{ほど|ba-hodo}、家賃[やちん]{は|wa-topic}安[やす]くなります。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot missing equally natural alternative が.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{の|no-possessive}山[やま]{は|wa-topic}星[ほし]{が|ga-subject}手[て]{で|de-means}取[と]れる{くらい/ぐらい/ほど|kurai-extent}近[ちか]く見[み]えました。
issues.problem: 星が手で取れる is unnatural; the set phrase is 手が届きそう.
issues.action: Rewrote as 山で見た星は手が届きそうなくらい近くに見えました, f=3, English adjusted.

issues.jp_before: 川[かわ]{の|no-possessive}水[みず]{は|wa-topic}冷[つめ]たくて、手[て]{が|ga-subject}動[うご]かない{くらい/ぐらい/ほど|kurai-extent}でした。
issues.problem: English 'would hardly move' did not match 動かない.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{の|no-possessive}日[ひ]{くらい/ぐらい|kurai-extent}{は|wa-contrast}家[いえ]{で|de-place}ゆっくり本[ほん]{を|o-object}読[よ]みたいです。

issues.action: Distractors changed to しか, ほど, ごろ.

issues.action: Distractors changed to しか, ほど, から.
